This meeting primarily focused on AI knowledge sharing and goal planning fo

r Project Checkpoint 2. Zhong Jiajin shared the differences between LNWiki

and LNWT, explaining how LNWiki analyzes documents, extracts entities, and

uses graph expansion to answer questions. Wang Yixi presented system evalua

tion results, noting that while the system returns relevant results, rankin

g needs improvement. The team discussed next-phase priorities, including mu

lti-data-source integration, PDF processing

especially images, tables, and

formulas

, toolset expansion, and Confluence integration. Tao emphasized t

he importance of creating Confluence documentation, suggesting that each mo

dule lead record their progress and ideas, and recommended standardized for

mats for tracking feature development and performance improvements. The mee

ting concluded with next-week action items, including Confluence page setup

, infrastructure building, and performance monitoring.

strong

Summary

strong

p local-id

d992e99d76e6

strong

82LL

MWiki vs. RAG Technology Comparison

strong

Zhong Jiajin shared AI knowledge on LLMWiki , distinguishing how these tech

nologies process documents and answer questions. LLMWiki organizes knowledg

e by analyzing key entities in documents and generating structured wiki pag

es, while LLMWiki employs graph expansion techniques to discover inter

91document connections and uses a four

91signal model to assess r

elevance. Zhong summarized the differences between LNWiki and traditional R

AG systems in terms of processing approach, knowledge state, retrieval meth

ods, and efficiency.

p local-id

c5eacba3b309

strong

Knowledge Graph Construction

Doc

ument Processing

strong

82The team discussed technical aspects of

knowledge graph construction and document handling. Zhong explained how LN

Wiki parses documents to generate metadata, including entity extraction and

text structuring. Wang Yixi reported evaluation results, showing the syste

m effectively retrieves relevant documents but requires ranking improvement

s. Dai Jiaxing outlined next-phase priorities

multi

91data

ource support, integration with different platforms, PDF processing enhance

ments

especially OCR and handling images

tables

, and toolset expansion.

p local-id

36dfcde51a9d

strong

Financial Dataset Handling

strong

82Dai Jiaxing shared a financial dataset

comprising multiple PDFs, some containing flowcharts that OCR could not eff

ectively extract. Wang Yixi noted that due to budget constraints, an end

91to

91end model might be more suitable. Tao suggested temporaril

y deprioritizing image processing in favor of text handling and recommended

integrating with Confluence first to read article contents.

p local-id

83cba413939b

strong

Platform Data Extraction

Optimiz

ation

strong

82Wang Yixi emphasized the importance of

platform data extraction and encouraged team members to independently explo

re optimization and enhancement directions for their modules. Tao proposed

creating dedicated Confluence pages to track progress and record implemente

d features, with Mu Guangyuan volunteering to manage these pages. The team

agreed that future meetings should focus more on each member sharing functi

onal updates and work demonstrations for their modules, rather than having

Wang Yixi unilaterally set plans.

p local-id

5ddbb0f248d3

strong

Feature Development Progress

strong

br

82Tao and Wang Yixi discussed progress on

feature development. Tao suggested that each sub

91team summarize cu

rrently implemented features at their layer and propose new feasible additi

ons, with a goal of completing open discussion and feature planning by next

week. Tao also proposed standardizing team meeting agendas, including proj

ect updates, knowledge sharing, and progress reports from each group, recom

mending each group prepare 1

933 concise slides to facilitate present

ations. Zhong Jiajin confirmed the target of conducting feature discussions

and planning by next Monday.

p local-id

1c63e5e69371

strong

Confluence Page Tracking System

stron

82Tao proposed creating a shared Confluen

ce page to track team progress and resolve issues. Mu Guangyuan and Dai Jia

xing agreed, and the group discussed page organization, including module

91based sections, status tracking, and contributor information. Wang Yi

xi mentioned the need for usage guidelines and suggested using English rath

er than Chinese for documentation. The discussion also touched on performan

ce test dataset selection, with Wang noting that existing datasets include

various test scenarios useful for evaluating system improvements.

p local-id

cc4b83f83d1d

strong

System Architecture

Interface De

sign

strong

82The team discussed system architecture

interfaces and tool integration. Wang Yixi advised everyone to expose stand

ardized interfaces when implementing new features and register tools in the

tool table, rather than using overly complex implementations. Tao stressed

the need to clearly define input

output requirements, similar to API contr

act design. Wang Yixi also outlined next week

s work plan, including buildi

ng the memory module, finalizing Confluence page processing, infrastructure

setup, and tool integration optimization. Mu Guangyuan requested that meet

ing minutes be placed on Confluence, and Zhong Jiajin confirmed that Mu wou

ld first set up the roadmap configuration on Confluence.
